enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Stretch legs. Curl up. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Stretch arms. Lie still.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Close cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Wash bowl.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Walk out.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Take out phone. Check messages. Put phone away. Look out window. Listen to music. Adjust headphones. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at workplace. Clock in. Put on uniform. Wash hands. Check schedule. Attend morning meeting. Review patient charts. Enter patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient records. Consult with doctor. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Attend afternoon meeting. Assist with procedure. Clean equipment. Clock out.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Put bag on lap. Take out book. Read. Put book away. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone away. Close eyes.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Close cabinet. Turn on stove. Pour oil into pot. Chop vegetables. Add vegetables to pot. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Stretch. Turn off TV. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Undress. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes. Brush teeth.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading or using phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Turn off light. Lie down.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Stretch legs. Curl up. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Stretch arms. Lie still.
